title: Villager-NoGo
description: A Datapack that disables the Villager AI (with “NoAI“) by giving them a specific name
body:
# Villagers - NoGo

![Player trading with libririan villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/181f4087524f5d4f9a4c6d91ea1c449dc8f7167f.png)



This Datapack allows player to set the "NoAI" Tag for Villagers to reduce the lag created by Villager Pathfinding.

## How to use?

### Disable AI:
You need to use a nametag to name a villager "disable_ai" (without quotation marks). The Nametag can be reused for multiple villagers. The Villagers that have "NoAI" are wearing a glass block on there head so you can see if they are no AI

### Enable AI: 
To reenable the pathfinding just use a Nametag with the name "enable_ai" (without quotation marks). It also can be reused so you don't need a Nametag for each villager

## FAQ:
My Villager does not level up when even if the level bar is full.
```
The villagers cant level up as long the AI is disable. Just enable the AI till it leveled up.
```

Can i disable the villager AI in Farms?
```
No you can't this Datapack is created for villagers you trade with
```

Will my villagers still restock there trades when they got NoAI?
```
Yes they will restock twice a day
```

How to remove the Datapack?

```
You can delete all of my Datapacks with the command "/function #monke-dev:uninstall"
Or only this one with "/function villager-nogo:uninstall"
```
